up: Return the exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL5483194. The output must include the compound ChEMBL ID (molecule_chembl_id), the activity type (standard_type), the standard value (standard_value), the standard units (standard_units), and the standard relation (standard_relation).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_relation FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5483194'
